title: Guardians of the Tower
summary: "Guardians of the Tower" by Randall Garrett is a science fiction novella written in the mid-20th century. This act of mercy leads to a pivotal shift, as the Wild One expresses a desire to join the Free People and understand their values of freedom and camaraderie.
